observations: In cultured human aortic smooth muscle cells, aliskiren 10⁻⁵ M reduced prorenin-induced Boyden-chamber migration by 66.4±18.1% (p<0.05); it did not significantly inhibit PDGF-BB-induced migration.

entities.name: Aliskiren
observations: In a HASMC migration assay, aliskiren inhibited migration induced by prorenin under the reported experimental conditions.

entities.name: Prorenin-induced HASMC migration
observations: Prorenin-induced migration of cultured human aortic smooth muscle cells was reduced by aliskiren 10⁻⁵ M by 66.4±18.1% (p<0.05) in a Boyden-chamber assay.
